name: APT Sentinel Checks
description: Consolidated work-hours sentinel checks. Sequential Neon queries = one connection window per run. Checks: time-anomaly (open clock-ins > 12h → push to admin role), stale-job (non-terminal jobs with no tech assigned > 3 days → push to dispatch role). WC scanner dropped — see ADR-009.

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Hourly 7am-6pm PT Mon-Fri. One execution window = one Neon connection burst. Timezone set via workflow settings.timezone = America/Los_Angeles.

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM time_records WHERE org_id = 'APT-CA' AND clock_in IS NOT NULL AND clock_out IS NULL AND clock_in < NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours'

nodes.name: Neon: Time Anomaly Query
nodes.notes: time-anomaly: clock-in records with no clock-out older than 12 hours. Indicates tech forgot to clock out or a session was left open. connectionTimeout=10s handles Neon cold start.

nodes.name: Code: Time Anomaly Eval
nodes.notes: Emits { finding: bool, summary, check, count }. finding=true if any clock-in has no clock-out after 12h.

nodes.name: IF: Time Anomaly Finding?
nodes.notes: true → push alert to admin role. false → continue to stale-job check.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ role: 'admin', payload: { title: 'Time Anomaly Alert', body: $json.summary } }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Time Anomaly Alert
nodes.notes: POST /api/push/send-role with role=admin. Uses 'CC API Key' Header Auth credential (x-api-key: DASHBOARD_API_KEY). continueOnFail=true so stale-job check always runs even if push endpoint is down.

parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jobs WHERE org_id = 'APT-CA' AND status NOT IN ('Complete', 'Archived') AND tech IS NULL AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'

nodes.name: Neon: Stale Job Query
nodes.notes: stale-job: non-terminal jobs with no tech assigned (tech IS NULL) created more than 3 days ago. Signal is unassigned ownership, not age alone — automation-immune unlike comms-based signals. connectionTimeout=10s.

nodes.name: Code: Stale Job Eval
nodes.notes: Emits { finding: bool, summary, check, count }. finding=true if any active job has tech=NULL after 3 days.

nodes.name: IF: Stale Job Finding?
nodes.notes: true → push alert to dispatch role. false → workflow ends cleanly.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ role: 'dispatch', payload: { title: 'Stale Job Alert', body: $json.summary } }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Stale Job Alert
nodes.notes: POST /api/push/send-role with role=dispatch. Uses 'CC API Key' Header Auth credential (x-api-key: DASHBOARD_API_KEY).
